guideline: - The training of annotators involved pre-reading a set of prepared and pre-existing material as well as a two-hour in-person seminar. The seminar was designed such that for each of the subtasks that the annotators were required to perform, they were provided with several worked examples that demonstrated how they should deal with ambiguous cases and a problem sheet.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on argument canonicalisation as an NLG task, treating it as a text generation/paraphrasing problem. Automatic evaluation uses ROUGE metrics on generated canonical arguments. No LLM-as-judge or human evaluation of generated outputs was conducted - all human annotation was for dataset creation and model training purposes.
